in_sanskrit.name: अक्रिति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Akriti in Sanskrit is derived from the Sanskrit words 'akrit' which means 'boundless' and 'iti' which means 'this'. Thus, Akriti can be interpreted as 'this which is boundless' or 'the one who is boundless'. It can also be translated as 'limitless' or 'endless'.
